scope: Recover the two infrastructure-invalid Nginx routes without rerunning the valid GLM and Kimi failures

recovery_design.trigger: Qwen and Flash hit EnvironmentStartTimeoutError while the custom Nginx image was being provisioned concurrently; GLM and Kimi subsequently ran cleanly.
recovery_design.outcome_selection_guard: Every infrastructure-invalid route is recovered and no verified route is rerun.
recovery_design.concurrency_correction: Provision and execute one Nginx sandbox at a time because the first run demonstrated same-image build contention.
recovery_design.wall_timeout_correction: Use 4800 seconds for the two sequential trials; the bound protects infrastructure validity and does not define task success.

effective_limits.wall_timeout_clock: absolute Unix wall time; includes laptop sleep

sandbox_budget.pricing_basis: same Daytona linear resource rates frozen for Gate 8 Wave 1
sandbox_budget.execution_policy: two sequential Harbor trials followed by a zero-sandbox cleanup check

interpretation_guard: Merge only learning-valid recovery rows with the two preserved verified rows; infrastructure failures remain excluded from training.
